heading: Monty Python star says he wants to be buried in Provence after surviving cancer
author: Times of India Editorial
paragraphs: Monty Python star Eric Idle, 83, has opened up about surviving pancreatic cancer, his peaceful life in Provence and his views on mortality. Idle also recalled a 2001 conversation with Beatles legend George Harrison about death and rebirth, revealing their differing beliefs about the afterlife during Harrison’s final days and his iconic comedy legacy.
